problem: The text says C "carries units that depend on n" and that "its value and unit depend on n". With T taken in minutes, C is simply the cutting speed at T = 1 min and its unit is m/min for every n. Only the numerical value of C changes with n, not the unit. A student may write C in odd units such as m/min·minⁿ in the exam.
fix: C is the cutting speed that gives T = 1 min, so C is in m/min. Its numerical value depends on the tool-work pair and on n, so C values for different n must not be compared directly; the unit stays m/min.
